mission.title: Poster Hunt
mission.description: Tear down Morpheus' posters around the City.

npc.say: Oh man. What else can go wrong today?

phase.briefing: Morpheus and his misguided followers are putting up posters around our City. These posters bear subversive words and images. You will find them and tear them down.

enter.say: Security cameras have spotted three posters inside that building.

complete.say: You have destroyed all of the posters there. Leave the building and wait for your next set of instructions.

phase.briefing: Another of Morpheus' posters has been found in a building nearby. You should be receiving the coordinates now--proceed to that location, find the poster, and destroy it.

enter.say: The poster is in that building. Find it and destroy it.

complete.say: Interesting. These posters appear to be attracting certain Exile elements.

phase.briefing: We have one more target building for you. I'm uploading the coordinates to you now: proceed to that location and destroy any remaining posters.

enter.say: There are four posters in that building. Destroy them all. We have not been able to contact the local security forces and warn them of your arrival, so if you encounter any human resistance, just eliminate them.

done.say: You've triggered an alarm! Expect incoming hostiles.

complete.say: You've destroyed all of the posters.

mission.finish: Without these posters, Morpheus cannot spread his subversive messages to the masses. Our next step will be eliminating his ability to produce further propaganda.
